CAMPUS ACADEMIC CALENDAR & SCHEDULE (ACADEMIC YEAR 2026-2027)
Office of the Dean of Academic Affairs

1. FALL SEMESTER 2026 SCHEDULE:
- Orientation & Document Verification for Freshmen: August 10, 2026 - August 14, 2026
- Course Registration & Fee Payment Deadline: August 20, 2026 (Late fee of $50 applies until August 25)
- Commencement of Classes: August 24, 2026
- Last Date for Course Add/Drop: September 4, 2026
- Mid-Semester Examinations: October 12, 2026 to October 17, 2026
- Mid-Term Grade Submission: October 26, 2026
- Annual College Cultural & Tech Fest (InnovateX): November 5 - November 7, 2026
- Last Day of Instruction: December 4, 2026
- Preparation Break / Study Holidays: December 5 - December 8, 2026
- End-Semester Final Examinations: December 9, 2026 to December 22, 2026
- Winter Vacation: December 23, 2026 to January 10, 2027

December 5 - December 8, 2026
- End-Semester Final Examinations: December 9, 2026 to December 22, 2026
- Winter Vacation: December 23, 2026 to January 10, 2027

2. SPRING SEMESTER 2027 SCHEDULE:
- Spring Registration & Fee Clearance: January 11, 2027
- Commencement of Spring Classes: January 15, 2027
- Mid-Semester Examinations: March 15, 2027 to March 20, 2027
- Spring Break: March 22, 2027 to March 27, 2027
- Last Day of Instruction: May 7, 2027
- End-Semester Final Examinations: May 12, 2027 to May 26, 2027
- Annual Convocation & Graduation Ceremony: June 15, 2027

Last Day of Instruction: May 7, 2027
- End-Semester Final Examinations: May 12, 2027 to May 26, 2027
- Annual Convocation & Graduation Ceremony: June 15, 2027

3. ACADEMIC POLICIES & ATTENDANCE REQUIREMENT:
- Mandatory Minimum Attendance: Every student must maintain at least 75% attendance in each registered subject to be eligible for end-semester examinations.
- Medical Condonation: Up to 10% condonation (minimum 65% aggregate) is permitted only upon submission of official hospital documentation within 3 working days of return.

STUDENT RESIDENTIAL SERVICES & HOSTEL MANUAL 2026-2027
Office of the Chief Warden

1. HOSTEL APPLICATION & ADMISSION PROCESS:
- Application Portal Opens: June 1, 2026
- Last Date for Hostel Application Submission: July 15, 2026 (strictly enforced)
- Room Allotment List Publication: July 28, 2026
- Hostel Check-in & Key Collection: August 12, 2026 onwards

2. FEE STRUCTURE (ANNUAL):
- Standard Double Occupancy (Air-Cooled): $2,400 (or ₹72,000) per academic year
- Single Occupancy (Air-Cooled, Senior/Graduate only): $3,100 (or ₹95,000) per academic year
- Deluxe AC Double Occupancy: $3,600 (or ₹1,10,000) per academic year
- Refundable Security Deposit: $300 (or ₹10,000) payable at the time of initial admission
- Mess & Dining Charges: $1,800 (or ₹54,000) per year (Includes 4 daily meals: Breakfast, Lunch, Evening Snack, Dinner)

payable at the time of initial admission
- Mess & Dining Charges: $1,800 (or ₹54,000) per year (Includes 4 daily meals: Breakfast, Lunch, Evening Snack, Dinner)

3. HOSTEL REGULATIONS & TIMINGS:
- Curfew / Gate Closing Time: All resident students must return to the hostel premises by 10:00 PM on weekdays and 10:30 PM on weekends.
- Night Out / Leave Passes: Students requesting overnight leave must apply through the student portal 24 hours in advance with parent/guardian verification.
- Visitor Policy: Parents and registered guardians are allowed in the visitor lounge between 9:00 AM and 6:00 PM. No external visitors are permitted inside student rooms.
- Prohibited Items: Electric heaters, cooking induction plates, immersion rods, and motorized vehicles without prior parking permits are strictly prohibited.
- Wi-Fi and Silent Study Hours: High-speed campus Wi-Fi is active 24/7. Mandatory silent study hours are observed from 11:00 PM to 6:00 AM.

CAMPUS PLACEMENT & INTERNSHIP GUIDELINES 2026-2027
Career Development & Corporate Relations Cell (CDCRC)

1. ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA FOR RECRUITMENT DRIVES:
- Cumulative Grade Point Average (CGPA): Minimum aggregate CGPA of 6.5 with no active backlogs at the start of the final year. Individual visiting companies may impose higher CGPA thresholds (e.g. 7.5+ or 8.0+).
- Registration Requirement: Students must register on the CDCRC Portal and upload a verified resume signed by the Faculty Advisor by August 15, 2026.
- Attendance at Pre-Placement Talks (PPT): Attendance is strictly mandatory for registered students. Missing a PPT without prior approval results in de-registration from that company's drive.

Attendance at Pre-Placement Talks (PPT): Attendance is strictly mandatory for registered students. Missing a PPT without prior approval results in de-registration from that company's drive.

2. "ONE STUDENT, ONE JOB" PLACEMENT POLICY:
- Core Offer Rule: Once a student receives a job offer with an annual package below $80,000 (₹12 LPA), they are considered "Placed" and are eligible to apply only for "Dream" or "Super Dream" category companies.
- Dream Category Threshold: Offers exceeding $80,000 (₹12 LPA) up to $130,000 (₹20 LPA).
- Super Dream Threshold: Offers exceeding $130,000 (₹20 LPA).
- Maximum Offers: A student can hold a maximum of 2 offers if the second offer is in a higher tier.

Offers exceeding $130,000 (₹20 LPA).
- Maximum Offers: A student can hold a maximum of 2 offers if the second offer is in a higher tier.

3. SUMMER INTERNSHIP POLICY:
- Minimum Duration: 8 weeks to 12 weeks during the summer break (June to August).
- Mandatory Evaluation: Students must submit an industry supervisor feedback form and project report within 14 days of completing their internship to receive 4 academic credits.

EXAMINATION REGULATIONS & EVALUATION SYSTEM
Office of the Controller of Examinations

1. EXAMINATION FEE DETAILS:
- Regular Semester End Examination Fee: $50 (or ₹1,500) per semester, payable along with the tuition installment.
- Supplementary / Backlog Examination Fee: $15 (or ₹450) per course/subject.
- Grade Revaluation / Answer Script Verification Fee: $25 (or ₹750) per subject.
- Official Transcript Issuance Fee: $10 (or ₹300) per copy.

2. GRADING SYSTEM & GRADE POINT EQUIVALENCY:
- Grade O (Outstanding): 90% and above | Grade Point: 10.0
- Grade A+ (Excellent): 80% to 89% | Grade Point: 9.0
- Grade A (Very Good): 70% to 79% | Grade Point: 8.0
- Grade B+ (Good): 60% to 69% | Grade Point: 7.0
- Grade B (Above Average): 55% to 59% | Grade Point: 6.0
- Grade C (Average / Pass): 50% to 54% | Grade Point: 5.0
- Grade F (Fail): Below 50% | Grade Point: 0.0 (Must reappear in supplementary exam)

3. REVALUATION & SCRIPT INSPECTION PROCEDURE:
- Students can apply for photocopy of evaluated answer scripts within 7 days of result declaration.
- Revaluation applications must be submitted within 15 days of result declaration.
- If revaluation results in a change of 5% or more, the updated grade is accepted and a fresh grade card is issued.

4. SCHOLARSHIPS & MERIT AWARDS:
- Dean's Merit Award: 100% tuition waiver for the top 3% students maintaining CGPA >= 9.5.
- Need-Based Financial Aid: Up to 50% fee concession for eligible applicants with family annual income below $30,000 (₹5,00,000). Applications open in September each year.
